study: Massy-Westropp et al., BMC Research Notes (2011), Northwest Adelaide Health Study, clinical stage 2 (2004–2006)
operator: kg per anatomical hand. Mean of three trials per hand, seated, Jamar analogue dynamometer. The authors described the cell distributions as normal. Group means and standard deviations are rounded. Participants with upper-limb symptoms or arthritis were excluded. The paper groups by anatomical side regardless of handedness, with 89% right-handed overall. It supplies no within-cell pairing or inter-hand correlation. The abstract and body give differing analytic sample counts; no cell-size weights are used.
